name: stockflow-supermarket
description: Backend REST en Node.js y TypeScript para StockFlow

scripts.db:up: docker start stockflow-postgres 2>/dev/null || (docker build -t stockflow-db ./database && docker run -d --name stockflow-postgres -p 5432:5432 -v stockflow_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data stockflow-db)
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --ext ts --exec ts-node --project tsconfig.json src/server.ts
scripts.dev:all: npm run db:up && sleep 2 && npm run dev
